requirement.description: The text_string function doesn't correctly handle all PDF text encodings, particularly for UTF-16BE encoded strings and special characters like the Euro sign. Tests are failing when trying to decode strings with special characters that should be converted to UTF-8.
requirement.contract: Function should properly decode both literal strings (with escape sequences) and hexadecimal strings (UTF-16BE) into proper Python strings. Special handling for Euro sign (0xA0) and other Unicode characters should be implemented.

requirement.description: The next_token function has issues with handling streams and comments properly, causing test failures. The stream detection logic doesn't correctly identify endstream markers, and comment handling isn't robust enough.
requirement.contract: Function should correctly identify and tokenize all PDF tokens including streams and comments. Stream tokens should be properly terminated by endstream markers regardless of line ending format. Comments should be handled consistently.

requirement.description: The parse_obj function has issues with handling dictionary and array structures properly, especially when comments are present or when processing references. It doesn't correctly process all token types in various contexts.
requirement.contract: Function should correctly parse PDF objects including dictionaries and arrays, properly handling embedded comments, and correctly processing reference objects (integer 0 R patterns) in both dictionaries and arrays.

requirement.description: The replace_ref function has incorrect logic for detecting and converting reference patterns in arrays. It's not properly recognizing the integer 0 R pattern that represents PDF references.
requirement.contract: Function should correctly detect and convert reference patterns (integer 0 R) in lists and arrays to complex number representations for PDF references.

requirement.description: These tests are failing due to missing sample PDF files in the ./samples/ directory. These tests require specific PDF files to be present for testing document loading and parsing functionality.
requirement.contract: Tests should not be run without the required sample PDF files. These are environment setup issues rather than code issues.
